node.title: B_ext crosses gate exactly at the S7 list window
node.notes: IN FLIGHT: PR #190 (Q2.4 executed). | FLIP on replay (Codex wave 3): PROVABLE -> PROVED.
node.statement: THE EXTENSION COLUMN NEEDS NO NEW THRESHOLD CALCULATION. `ext_pole_floor` supplies the extension-pole witness count N(L) and its gate-crossing formula, in which the extension parameter L is exactly the base list-window parameter of the S7 list side. Hence B_ext >= gate holds exactly at the base-row list window where the S7 list threshold is met, after the floor convention already included in `ext_pole_floor`.
